text: Brand communication for digital, print and outdoor
I am a graphic designer with media agency experience, creating brand communication for digital and print.
My work spans social campaigns, brand identities, editorial layouts, presentations and vehicle branding.
Festive colour, bilingual messaging and a rooftop installation create a distinctive travelling campaign.
The campaign photographs show the wrap and rooftop concept together on the finished vehicle.
A consistent maroon and white palette connects scholarship, alumni and student opportunity messages.
Large figures and focused imagery make each message easy to scan.
Campaign adaptation across coach and electric bus formats
Product photography leads the layout, supported by a strong red field and a clear headline.
A red and white visual system carries different product messages into outdoor placements.
Home security communication with product-led compositions and clear calls to action
Action photography and bold blue and red headlines connect coaching, motivation and participation messages.
Olive, orange and warm neutrals connect a series of health awareness posts.
Recurring colour, typography and image treatment organise a range of wellness topics.
Gold accents and a dark palette frame food imagery, categories and pricing.
A presentation system that pairs brand colour with structured layouts for positioning, strategy and business communication.
